text:
Try this today: open ChatGPT or Gemini and ask, "Best [your service] in [your city] for [your typical customer]?"

If your business doesn't show up, it's usually not about size. AI tools recommend businesses whose websites clearly state:
→ What exactly they do, and where
→ Prices or at least a price range
→ Real answers to the questions customers ask (timelines, process, what's included)
→ Consistent details on Google Business Profile and directories

"Price on request" and a homepage that says "Welcome to our website" give the AI nothing to quote.

The good news: this is a content fix, not an ad budget. A clear services page and an honest FAQ go a long way.
